name: FlickLock hypermotion — TikTok/Reels 9:16 with accesify outro
prompt: Premium cinematic product hypermotion. Open on the top-down macro of the matte black AirPods Pro 3 case shown in the start image, FlickLock slider mint-green button and green LED indicator visible at center. Camera slow dolly-in 5 percent over 2 seconds, locked on the slider mechanism. At second 2, a thumb enters from frame LEFT, makes contact with the mint-green slider button, and pushes it from LEFT TO RIGHT (rightward motion, matching the arrow direction on the button itself). The green LED brightens with a soft bloom as the slider reaches its rightward end position. Camera tilts up smoothly transitioning from top-down to a low three-quarter angle as the magnetic lid lifts and floats open in slow motion. Camera pulls back revealing AirPods Pro 3 inside the case with soft rim light. Slow 90 degree orbit reveals the case profile, then fades to pure black. Final frame: minimalist black background with the accesify wordmark. STRICT PRODUCT PRESERVATION: case, slider, LED, AirPods Pro 3 must remain identical to start image; same proportions, shape, orientation, mint-green slider color preserved exactly. STRICT MOTION: the slider moves LEFT TO RIGHT only, never the opposite. The lid opens upward and away from the camera. The thumb is realistic, no AI uncanny detail. Premium Dyson and Apple cinematography, warm-cool grade, deep blacks. No text overlays except the final accesify outro.
